question: Who among the following has written the Hindi novel 'Kafan'?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Premchand.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Hindi Novel Kafan is written by **Munshi Premchand.**
 
• Kafan (The Shroud), by Premchand, translated from Urdu and Hindi by **Frances W.** **Pritchett**.
 
• In **1936**, Premchand also published "Kafan" ("Shroud"), in which a poor man collects money for the funeral rites of his dead wife, but spends it on food and drink.
 
• The story Kafan, by Munshi Premchand, is a classic social-realistic tale of **downtrodden victimhood**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sumitranandan Pant **was an Indian poet. He was one of the most celebrated 20th-century of Hindi language and was known for romanticism in his poems which were inspired by nature, people, and beauty within.
 
• **Mahadevi Varma** was an Indian Hindi-language poet, essayist, sketch story writer, and eminent personality of Hindi literature.
 
• **Jaishankar Prasad** was a prominent figure in modern Hindi literature as well as Hindi theatre. Prasad was his pen name. He was also known as a Chhayavadi poet.
